name: telnyxWebhook
script: # determine status based on callback event_type status_string = { 'fax.created': 'Created', 'fax.queued': 'Queued', 'fax.media.processed': 'Media Processed', 'fax.sending.started': 'Sending', 'fax.delivered': 'Delivered', 'fax.failed': 'Failed' } failure_reason_string = { 'user_busy': 'the user is busy.', 'file_size_limit_exceeded': 'the document is over 50mb.', 'page_count_limit_exceeded': 'the document has more than 350 pages.', 'fax_signaling_error': 'the receiver did not respond. Please try again.', 'file_download_failed': 'the document cant be downloaded. Please make sure that the file is accessible.', 'file_format_invalid': 'the document is not a valid PDF file.', 'receiver_call_dropped': 'the sending was dropped prematurely. Please try again.', 'receiver_communication_error': 'an error occured in the Telnyx Telephony Engine. Please try resending the fax.', 'receiver_decline': 'the receiver declined the send attempt. Please try again.', 'receiver_invalid_number_format': 'the telephone number is not valid +E.164 format. Please refer to this article for the correct format', 'receiver_no_response': 'the receiver did not response. Please try again.', 'receiver_recovery_on_timer_expire': 'the receiver did not respond on time. Please try again.', 'receiver_unallocated_number': 'the receivers number is currently unallocated (unassigned).', 'service_unavailable': 'an error occured with the service while sending. Please try again.' } if frappe.form_dict.data: data = frappe.form_dict.data # get request data event_type = data['event_type'] # get status of_name = frappe.db.exists('Outgoing Fax', {'tracking_id': data['payload']['fax_id']}) # get doc that has hook's id if of_name: of_doc = frappe.get_doc('Outgoing Fax', of_name) of_doc.status = status_string[event_type] # update doc status # update fields based on status if event_type == 'fax.sending.started': of_doc.date_sent = frappe.utils.get_datetime(data['occurred_at'][:-1]) if event_type == 'fax.delivered': of_doc.date_delivered = frappe.utils.get_datetime(data['occurred_at'][:-1]) if event_type == 'fax.failed': reason = data['payload']['failure_reason'] of_doc.date_failed = frappe.utils.get_datetime(data['occurred_at'][:-1]) of_doc.failure_reason = failure_reason_string[reason] of_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Get File Details
script:
# if the outgoing fax is new, do the following before inserting to the database: 
last_file = frappe.get_last_doc('File') # get the last file doc created
doc.file_id = last_file.name # set the file_id field of the fax doc
doc.file_hash = last_file.content_hash # set the file_hash field of the fax doc

name: Make Attachment Private
script:
# do the following if fax doc is delivered or failed before saving:
if doc.status == 'Delivered' or doc.status == 'Failed':
    file_name = frappe.db.get_value('File', doc.file_id, 'file_name')
    file_url_private = f'/private/files/{file_name}'
    private_file_name = frappe.db.exists('File', {'file_url': file_url_private})
    
    if not private_file_name:
        file_doc = frappe.get_doc('File', doc.file_id) # get the file doc of the attachment
        file_doc.is_private = 1 # set to private
        file_doc.save(ignore_permissions=True) # save file doc
        doc.media_url = file_doc.file_url # update the fax doc's media_url field
        
    else:
        private_file_doc = frappe.get_doc('File', private_file_name)
        doc.file_id = private_file_doc.name
        doc.media_url = private_file_doc.file_url
